findings.detail: Build House: wood: no drop of ~25 on screen
findings.explanation: One villager shift-placed 6 houses at 25:13.7-25:16.7; only 5 drops of 25 wood follow (also on video), so one foundation never went down. By timing it is the 3rd placement (25:14.712, map 67/65, next to the 4th at 65/66); the matcher pins the missing drop on the last one because all six cost the same. The replay records commands even when the game rejects them.
